_comment: HUMAN-OWNED (reviews/22_site_fit). The operator's building prototypes, copied from the defaults of their own SiteFit site-planning tool. site_fit.py loads this file once per process and freezes it by SHA-256; the runner refuses an experiment while it differs from git HEAD. The agent never edits it. A human edits it only between runs; once any zoning jurisdiction is verified, an edit changes BTS ratings, so start a new run and baseline afterwards. All lengths in feet.
fit_rule: The full envelope (building L x W plus, per dock side, truck court and trailer parking) must lie inside the setback-buffered buildable area. Truck drives and circulation are not modelled. Each prototype keeps its depth and shrinks its length in step_ft steps, from L down to min_length_ft, at the best orientation.

cross.label: cross-dock
cross.min_length_note: 600 ft keeps the building at least as long as it is deep (L >= W = 520); 600 x 520 = 312,000 SF

front.label: front-load
front.min_length_note: 400 x 260 = 104,000 SF, the first lattice length at or above 100K SF

rear.label: rear-load
rear.min_length_note: 400 x 260 = 104,000 SF, the first lattice length at or above 100K SF
